subject: Draft MAP & procurement timeline — HealthBridge private offer (AWS/Azure)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Internal draft: MAP + procurement milestones for HealthBridge private offer

Team —

Attached is a working Mutual Action Plan (HB_MAP_v1.xlsx) I put together after the call with John and Aisha this morning. The buyer is clear they want a single private offer that covers both AWS Marketplace and an Azure equivalent (they'll use Azure credits for some workloads but want the purchase on AWS for accounting).

Quick summary of risks and asks:
- Finance needs to confirm net-30 vs net-45 invoicing for this account (Michael, can you confirm by EOD Tue?).
- Procurement requires a vendor W-9 and SOC2 summary for their security review (attached).
- HealthBridge procurement has a target PO cutoff: they want supplier acceptance by 2026-12-07 to hit their FY close.

Proposed milestones in the sheet: discovery + legal redlines (due 12/01), AWS private offer creation (12/02), buyer PO issuance (12/05), Redwood acceptance and invoice (12/06), GA deployment window (12/15).

Please review the timeline and highlight anything that would push us into next quarter. Ben/karthik — I'll need you to run the private offer flow with Marketplace ops and confirm the exact fields HealthBridge procurement needs for their PO (tax ID, remit address, invoice email).

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: HB_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: John Lee <john.lee@healthbridge.ai>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@healthbridge.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: MAP & next steps for HealthBridge private offer (AWS + Azure notes)

John / Aisha / Procurement team —

Great speaking with you yesterday. Per our conversation I’m sharing a concise Mutual Action Plan and a recommended procurement path so we can align on dates and responsible owners. Main points below; full plan attached (HB_MAP_v1.xlsx).

What we (Redwood) will do:
- Provide SOC2 summary and vendor W-9 by 11/30 (attached).
- Produce the AWS Private Offer and the Azure partner billing guide by 12/02 (Ben & Karthik).
- Accept PO on behalf of Redwood and generate an invoice for the committed reserved capacity on 12/06.

What HealthBridge will do:
- Confirm internal budget and routing for the PO by 12/03.
- Share the exact PO template and remit-to contact (Procurement).
- Complete security questionnaire by 12/01 if possible; else provide a list of blockers.

Key dates: buyer PO cutoff 12/05 to meet your FY close — if we miss this we’ll need to discuss interim credit terms.

Action items for you: please reply with the procurement contact and the PO template, and confirm whether a net-30 invoice is acceptable.

Regards,
Hannah

Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf; AWS_PrivateOffer_Instructions.pdf

From: John Lee <john.lee@healthbridge.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@healthbridge.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@healthbridge.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T13:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & next steps for HealthBridge private offer (AWS + Azure notes)

Thanks Hannah — this looks good. A couple clarifications from procurement:

1) Our PO template requires a specific marketplace supplier name and a remit address. Can you confirm the exact legal entity to use on the PO and the tax ID?
2) We typically pay net-45 for marketplace contracts; we can make an exception for net-30 if it gets signed before 12/05, otherwise net-45 will be the default.
3) We also need a short SOW that lists the committed reserved capacity (GPU hours / vCPU equivalent) and the start/end dates for the contracted term. Can you draft a one-page SOW?

I'll attach our PO_Template and a procurement checklist. If we can get your acceptance and invoice in our system by 12/06, procurement will route payment in the first week of January.

On next steps — I will: share the PO template by 11/30 EOD and confirm the internal approver. Aisha will handle security questionnaire items.

Regards,
John
Chief Product Officer
HealthBridge Analytics
john.lee@healthbridge.ai

Attachment: PO_Template_HealthBridge.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Marketplace steps & vendor details for HealthBridge (internal)

Hannah / Karthik —

Quick update after the ops call with Marketplace: the vendor legal entity to put on the PO is "Redwood Inference, Inc." with EIN 27-1234567 and remit address: 650 2nd St, San Francisco, CA 94107. Finance (Michael) confirmed we can do net-30 for this deal if the acceptance occurs by 2026-12-06. After that, default net-45.

We need the one-page SOW from you, Hannah, that lists: committed GPU hours per month, billing cadence (monthly in arrears), and term (12 months starting on the acceptance date). I started the private offer creation workflow and hit two items we need from the buyer: (1) legal contact for acceptance and (2) billing contact for invoice routing. I included AWS_PrivateOffer_Instructions.pdf for reference.

- Ben
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: John Lee <john.lee@healthbridge.ai>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@healthbridge.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T11:10:00-08:00
Subject: One-page SOW + updated MAP (version 2)

John / Aisha —

Attached is the one-page SOW and an updated MAP (I added specific fields required for the AWS private offer). Summary:
- Committed reserved capacity: 320 GPU hours / month equivalent (quantified in the SOW).
- Term: 12 months starting on acceptance date.
- Billing: monthly in arrears; invoice due net-30 if acceptance occurs by 12/06; otherwise net-45.

Aisha — if you can confirm the security questionnaire gaps by EOD today we can note them in the MAP and proceed with acceptance. John — once you send the PO template we’ll populate it with the legal entity and ship back for signature.

Thanks,
Hannah

Attachment: HB_MAP_v2.xlsx; PO_Populated_Draft.pdf; HB_SOW_1page.pdf

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@healthbridge.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, John Lee <john.lee@healthbridge.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@healthbridge.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: One-page SOW + updated MAP (version 2)

Thanks Hannah — we reviewed HB_SOW_1page.pdf and the MAP. A few notes from security: we need the SOC2 summary (you attached), plus confirmation on data residency for logs (we prefer US-only retention). Can you confirm log retention policy and whether we can enable a VPC-only deployment?

Procurement: we will issue a PO on 12/05 once legal confirms the populated PO. Payment team accepts net-30 if we get the signed invoice by 12/06; otherwise we default to net-45.

I'll circulate the PO_Template internally this afternoon.

Regards,
Aisha
Head of Infrastructure, HealthBridge Analytics
